question: Mention the base set size and set code of the set that was in block named "Masques" and "Mirage".
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching set_translations record.
gold: SELECT DISTINCT T1.baseSetSize, T2.setCode FROM sets AS T1 LEFT JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T2.setCode = T1.code WHERE T1.block IN ('Masques', 'Mirage')
gold0: SELECT DISTINCT T1.baseSetSize, T2.setCode FROM sets AS T1 INNER JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T2.setCode = T1.code WHERE T1.block IN ('Masques', 'Mirage')

d.request: Mention the base set size and set code of the sets in the blocks named "Masques" and "Mirage", and also include sets that have no matching record in the set_translations table.
d.sql: SELECT s.baseSetSize, s.code FROM sets s WHERE s.block IN ('Masques', 'Mirage') OR s.code NOT IN (SELECT setCode FROM set_translations WHERE setCode IS NOT NULL)

c.request:
Mention the base set size and set code of the set that was in block named "Masques" and "Mirage".
Also keep rows that have no matching set_translations record.
c.sql: SELECT s.baseSetSize, s.code FROM sets s LEFT JOIN set_translations st ON st.setCode = s.code WHERE s.block IN ('Masques', 'Mirage')

b.request: List the base set size and set code of every set whose block is either "Masques" or "Mirage", using a LEFT JOIN from sets to set_translations on setCode so that sets with no matching set_translations record are still included
b.sql: SELECT s.baseSetSize, s.code FROM sets AS s LEFT JOIN set_translations AS st ON s.code = st.setCode WHERE s.block IN ('Masques', 'Mirage')
